t_advice_summary_textbox.text: orange green red blue lead to the same forest, the other colours lead to another. I need to figrue out which forest has the most mushrooms and try to always go to that one

vb_textbox.text: Focus on just one set of colours: Red, blue, orange, green (or the opposite colours). It's easier to remember just four colours than try to think which colour belongs to which category. Try these sets of colours first, and see how many mushrooms you get. If you get above 6 mushrooms, it's likely that this set of colours will be the right choice going forwards. If this reduces below this, maybe consider switching to the other colour set and see if it performs better. Don't assume that one set of colours will be the best set the whole way through, as it changes a lot. Good luck!
